title: Triviality of the bC Character
body_html:
Triviality of the bC Character

The quadratic determinant character \(\chi_{b_C}\) attached to the isotropic subspace \(b_C\) is trivial on \(\Delta^0\): \[ \chi_{b_C}(g,\alpha(g))=1. \]
proof_html: The proof identifies \(b_C\) with the radical \(r\) as a \(G_x^0\)-module. It reduces the determinant character to a unitary group over a quadratic field. If \(s\) is integral, the layer is equivariantly isomorphic to the reductive quotient Lie algebra, whose adjoint determinant is square. If \(s\) is half-integral, the graded endomorphism space is decomposed by jump classes; paired dual summands and unitary/orthogonal/symplectic determinant constraints make the total Legendre character trivial.
